cases.description: `## Grault`, `## Other `, `## Grault` and `## Other` give the derived anchors `grault`, `other`, `grault-1` and `other-1`, listed with the explicit `grault` that duplicates the first (§6.1, step 7); GitHub gives `other-` to the second heading and `other` to the fourth, since it keeps the space next to the anchor element (decision C13).
